from pathlib import Path

source='''from collections import defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    positions = defaultdict(list)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value:
                positions[value].append((r, c))

    boxes = {}
    for color, cells in positions.items():
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        rh, cw = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
        boundary = {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)} | {(r1, c) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)} | {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)} | {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)}
        if all(grid[r][c] == color for r, c in boundary):
            boxes[color] = (r0, c0, rh, cw)

    sources = []
    for color, (r0, c0, rh, cw) in boxes.items():
        interior = [(r, c) for r in range(r0 + 1, r0 + rh - 1)
                    for c in range(c0 + 1, c0 + cw - 1)
                    if grid[r][c] == color]
        if interior:
            sources.append((color, r0, c0, rh, cw, interior))
    if len(sources) != 1:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    src_color, sr, sc, sh, sw, src_interior = sources[0]
    pattern = {(r - sr, c - sc) for r, c in src_interior}
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, (r0, c0, rh, cw) in boxes.items():
        if color == src_color or (rh, cw) != (sh, sw):
            continue
        for dr, dc in pattern:
            out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = color
    return out
'''
